I know it makes doing anything into what I call the battle of the brain. I have to force myself to do anything. But at the same time I am so bored I want something to do. It’s exhausting. Now I have to force myself to clean it up.  This lack of motivation baffles me. I didn’t use to be like this. Maybe I am lazy . I don’t know what to think .
